title: ttheme work
description:
One work — a series, a game, a franchise — and its characters, in the order its cast is listed: commons/works/<work>.toml in the ttheme repository, or works/<work>.toml in a marketplace that proposes a work or a character the commons does not hold yet. Its file name is the work's id
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#works-and-characters

tag.description: One booru tag, as the site spells it

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editor completion and checks; ttheme ignores it

name.description: The work's name as lists show it, its shelf ordered by it

native.description: The work's title in its original language, shown dim beside its name

lead.description: Whose colors stand for the work: one of its characters, as <work>/<character>, or the work itself; without it, its first character

character.description: The work's characters, in the order its cast is listed, which cast order sorts its palettes by

id.description: The character's id within the work: a palette of it names <work>/<id> as its subject

native.description: The character's names in the work's original language, the full name first, then any other it goes by; search matches them

danbooru.description: The character's danbooru tag, which says who the character is: one character has one tag across the commons. find searches it for pictures, and it names the character in every language

also.description: Other works in the commons whose shelves list this character too, as their ids

sites.description: The character's tag on sites that name it otherwise, which find searches there in place of the danbooru tag: one tag, or a list find searches together (two on danbooru, any number on konachan and yande.re, one on zerochan); an empty list skips the site
